definitions.explanation: The mental processes and emotional state of a person; the study of the mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心理|しんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{心理|しんり}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧{心理|しんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マーケティング→マーケティング：05222_maaketingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Understanding consumer psychology is fundamental to marketing.

notes:
{心理|しんり} refers to the inner workings of the mind — a person's mental processes, emotional states, and psychological tendencies. It can also refer to psychology as a field of study.

COMPOUNDS:
- {心理|しんり}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧: psychology (academic discipline)
- {心理|しんり}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: psychological
- {心理|しんり}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: mental/psychological state
- {心理|しんり}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: psychological test
- ⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧{心理|しんり}: consumer psychology
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧{心理|しんり}: criminal psychology

WATCH OUT:
⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧ (truth, ultimate truth) is pronounced identically. Context usually makes the meaning clear, but in speech they can cause momentary ambiguity.
